description: Other-agent claims in player input (#180, FR-RESP-11): what the player's input says another character does, says or thinks. A do sentence whose subject is another modeled character (its name first, after an optional lead word, or a subject pronoun resolved to the last-mentioned character) is that character's action; with one of these verbs, or a quotation, it is that character's speech; with an inner-state cue (inner_state.json) it is a thought. In the player's say only quoted speech attributed to another character counts: a quotation next to '<name> <verb>' or '<verb> <name>'. A subject joined with the player ('Jenni and I') stays the player's own action. The first-person words of a narrated span are rewritten to the player character's name. Every inflection is listed (no stemmer). A detector side-channel: it makes no claim.
